items.title: DEFENSE
items.quote: Grant me justice, O G-d. Take up my struggle against a nation that does not practice humane principles.
items.text: When you are confronted by cruel enemies who seek to harm you, ask Hashem to act for you by defeating them.

items.title: LIBERATION
items.quote: Liberate me from a man of deceit and injustice.
items.text: When you are being victimized by an unscrupulous individual, ask Hashem to frustrate his evil intentions.

items.title: STRENGTH
items.quote: For You are the G-d of my strength. Why have You forsaken me?
items.text: Declare your continued reliance upon Hashem and ask Him to restore His closeness to you.

items.title: GUIDANCE
items.quote: Send Your light and Your truth. They will guide me.
items.text: Look for Hashem’s guidance, based upon the light of the Torah.

items.title: DELIGHT
items.quote: I will then come to the altar of G-d, to G-d, the joy of my delight.
items.text: – Visualize your delight in restoring your closeness with Hashem.

items.title: COMFORT
items.quote: Why are you downcast, my soul, and confused within me? Wait and look to G-d!
items.text: Work on yourself to restore your optimism and have faith that your Geulah will surely come.
